FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 100 PFH 2022 Dated:17-06-
2022 regarding altering the limits of Mundagadore and Allapattana village of
Srirangapatna Taluk and Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village
called Doddapalya and Chikkapalya was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette No. RD 100 PFH 2022 dated:08-07-2022 inviting objections or suggestions
from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 30-07-2022.
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

(283)

5SY BFE WBW, Aeros, OF, BBO, 909% on YA

village Mundagadore and Allapattana of Srirangapatna taluk in MandyaDistrict to
form a new revenue village called Doddapalya of Srirangapatna taluk Mandya
district along with survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 160 GLH 2022 Dated:19-
08-2022 regarding altering the limits of Hebberalu village of Maddur Taluk and
Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called Kurubaradoddi was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 160 GLH 2022
dated:25-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:19-09-
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Hebberalu of Maddur taluk in Mandya District to form a new revenue

village called Kurubaradoddi of Maddur taluk Mandya district along with survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 230 PFH 2022 Dated:10-
10-2022 regarding altering the limits of Horuncha village of Yadagiri Taluk and

Yadagiri District and constituting a new revenue village called Shivajinagar was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 230 PFH 2022
dated:12-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:21-10-2022

the State Government;

Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

village Horuncha of Yadagiri taluk in Yadagiri District to form a new revenue
village called Shivajinagar of Yadagiri taluk Yadagiri district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 99 PFH 2022 Dated:20-06-
2022 regarding altering the limits of Kiranguru village of Srirangapattana Taluk
and Mandya. District and constituting a new revenue village called Kaparanakopplu
and Kengalakopplu was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD
99 PFH 2022 dated:08-07-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:08-07-
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Kiranguru of Srirangapattana taluk in Mandya District to form a new
revenue village called Kaparanakopplu of Srirangapattana taluk Mandya district
along with survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA
RD 95 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date: 06-01-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 95 PFH 2022 Dated:-22-06-
2022 regarding altering the limits of Kirugavalu Village of Malavalli Taluk and
Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called Bullikempanadoddi
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 95 PFH 2022 dated
14-07-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:
14-08-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-I
Lands bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Kirugavalu of Malavalli Taluk in Mandya District to form a new revenue
village called as Bullikempanadoddi, of Malavalli Taluk, Mandya District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

RD 102 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:04-01-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 102 PFH 2022 Dated:17-06-
2022 regarding altering the limits of Bonthaganahalli village of Srirangapattana
Taluk and Mandya. District and constituting a new revenue village called
Kokkarehundi was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD
102 PFH 2022 dated:08-07-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:
30-07-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Bonthaganahalli of Srirangapattana taluk in Mandya District to form a new

revenue village called Kokkarehundi of Srirangapattana taluk Mandya district
along with survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 06 PFH Dated:09-02-2022
regarding altering the limits of Kolur village of Muddebihal Taluk and Vijayapur
District and constituting a new revenue village called Vijayanagar was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 06 PFH 2022 Dated:11-02-2022 Part 4A
Page No 2065 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:01-08-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Muddebihala taluk ,Vijayapur District to form a new revenue village
called as Vijayanagar of Muddebihala taluk ,Vijayapur District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 24 PFH 2021 Dated:01/02/2022
regarding altering the limits of Koppa village of Muddebihal Taluk and Vijayapur
District and constituting a new revenue village called Sevalal Nagar was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 24 PFH 2021 dated:04/02/2022 Part 4A
Page No 1539 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:
01/08/2022 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Muddebihal taluk ,Vijayapur District to form a new revenue village called
as Sevalal Nagar of Muddebihal taluk ,Vijayapur District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 189 PFH 2022 Dated:19-08-2022
regarding altering the limits of S.I.Honnalagere village of Maddur Taluk and
Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called H.Hosuru was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 189 PFH 2022
dated:26-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:-
19-09-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Maddur taluk in Mandya District to form a new revenue village called

H.Hosuru of Maddur taluk Mandya district along with survey numbers included in
column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 250 PFH 2022
Dated:11-10-2022 regarding altering the limits of Shettikera village of Shahapur
Taluk and Yadagiri District and constituting a new revenue village called
Tayammadevinagar was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land

Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD
250 PFH 2022 dated:14-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:22-10-2022

And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Shettikera of Shahapur Taluk in Yadagiri district to form the a new revenue
village called Tayammadevinagar of Shahapur Taluk, Yadgir district along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof

Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No.
RD 278 PFH 2022 dated:13-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:14-10-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Ullesuguru of Vadagera taluk in Yadagiri District to form a new revenue
village called Lakshmannayak of Vadagera taluk Yadagiri district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 44 GLH 2022 Date 04-04-2022
regarding altering the limits of Chunchanahalli village Nagamangala Taluk and
Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called Ramananda Nagara
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 44 GLH 2022
dated:.16-04-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 41 PFH 2022 Dated:
04-04-2022. regarding altering the limits of Bettadamallenahalli village of
Nagamangala Taluk Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called
Chikkaveeranakoppalu and Balanakoppalu was published as required by section 6
of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the
Karnataka Gazette No. RD 41 PFH 2022 dated:16-04-2022 inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from
the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:
16-04-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by the
State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing Survey numbers as specified in column(2) of the table below and
areas specified in column (3) there of shall be excluded from the limits of Said
Bettadamallenahalli Village of Nagamangala taluk, Mandya district to form a new
revenue village called as Balanakoppalu of Nagamangala taluk Mandya district.
The new survey numbers which will form part of this new village are as specified in
column (4) thereof

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RD 388 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:04-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Arasinakera Village of Koppal Taluk Koppal District and to constitute a new
revenue village called Arasinakera tanda as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Koppal District, Koppal.

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
Village Arasinakera of Koppal Taluk Koppal District to form a new revenue village
called Arasinakera tanda of Koppal Taluk Koppal district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Bengaluru, Date:04-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the

Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Jamaga(R)Village of Aland taluk Kalaburagi District and to constitute a new
revenue village called Ramanagar Tanda as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Kalaburagi District, Kalaburagi

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Jamaga(R) of Aland taluk in Kalaburagi District to form a new revenue
village called Ramanagar Tanda of Aland taluk Kalaburagi district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Thalavatti Village of Hiriyuru taluk Chitradurga District and to constitute a new
revenue village called Bandlorahatti as specified in schedule along with maps with
old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Chitradurga District, Chitradurga

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Thalavatti of Hiriyuru taluk in Chitradurga District to form a new revenue
village called Bandlorahatti of Hiriyur Taluk Chitradurga District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking in to consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the karnatka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area of the village, the demand under land revenue in the village
and having regard to the administrative convenience, The Government of Karnatka
proposes to issue a notification to alter the limits of Anapur Village of Gurumatkal
Taluk, Yadgiri District and to constitute a new village called Hanumanpur as specified
in the schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new survey numbers
assigned to them.

Now therefore in exercise in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the
said Act notice is hereby given for the information off all persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken in to consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to said proposal before the date specified above will be
considered by the state Government, Objections or suggestions may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Yadgiri District, Yadgiri.

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RD 182 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:04-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Talluru of Yalaburga taluk Koppal District and to constitute a new revenue village
called Shivapura as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers
and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government from
any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will be
considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner, Koppal District, Koppal

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Talluru of Yalaburga taluk in Koppal District to form a new revenue village
called Shivapura of Yalaburga taluk Koppal district along with the survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village

Bengaluru, Date:04-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Sonnapur Village of Hunasagi taluk Yadagiri District and to constitute a new
revenue village called Jairamnagar as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected

thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Yadagiri District, Yadagiri
SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Sonnapur of Hunasagi taluk in Yadagiri District to form a new revenue
village called Jairamnagar of Hunasagi taluk Yadagiri district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Rajanakollur Village of Hunasagi taluk Yadagiri District and to constitute a new
revenue village called Balajinagar, Paruthnayak nagar and Maruthinagar as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to
them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Yadagiri District, Yadagiri

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas specified
in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said village
Rajanakollur of Hunasagi taluk in Yadagiri District to form a new revenue village called
Balajinagar of Hunasagi taluk Yadagiri district along with the survey numbers included in
column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
R Hosalli Village of Yadgir taluk Yadgir District and to constitute a new revenue

village called Shriramnagar as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Yadgir District, Yadgir

Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Malhar
& Lingeri Village of Yadgir taluk Yadgir District and to constitute a new revenue
village called Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Nagar & Nagarabanda as specified in schedule
along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Yadgir District, Yadgir

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
No. RD 411 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretaraiat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Dated:04-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the power conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the
factors specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules
1966 such as the population, area of the village, the demand under land revenue in the
village and Other Head Of the account and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the government of Karnataka proposes to issue a notification to alter the
limits of Kakkasagera village of Shahapur Taluk Yadgir District and to constitute
a new village called Kashi Nagar as specified in schedule along with Maps with Old
Survey Numbers and new assigned to them.

Now therefore, in exercise of the Powers conferred by section 6 of The
said Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the person likely to be
affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty
days from the date of publication of the Notification in the official gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State
Government from any person with respect to the said Proposal before the date
specified above will be considered by the State Government. Objections or
suggestions may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Yadgir District, Yadgir

SCHEDULE-I
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Kakkasagera of Shahapur Taluk in Yadgir district to form the a new
revenue village called Kashi Nagar of Shahapur Taluk, Yadgir district along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue

specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Jumalpur Village of Hunasagi Taluk Yadagiri District and to constitute a new
revenue village called Dharmapur as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Jogundabavi Village of Hunasgi Taluk yadgiri District and to constitute a new
revenue villages called Anjaneya Nagar, Devingar, & Basarigida Nagar as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to
them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, yadgiri District, yadgiri.

Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors

such as the population, area of the village, the demand under land revenue in the
village and Other Head Of the account and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the government of Karnataka proposes to issue a notification to alter the
limits of Hothpet village of Shahapur Taluk Yadgir District and to constitute a new
villages called Venkateshwar Nagar & Sevalal Nagar (Tanda) (Ho) as specified in
schedule along with Maps with Old Survey Numbers and new assigned to them.

Now therefore, in exercise of the Powers conferred by section 6 of The said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the person likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the Notification in the official gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any person with respect to the said Proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestions may be addressed
to the Deputy Commissioner, Yadgir District, Yadgir

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the power conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village, the demand under land revenue in the
village and Other Head Of the account and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the government of Karnataka proposes to issue a notification to alter the
limits of Gundahalli village of Shahapur Taluk Yadgir District and to constitute a
new village called Hosagundahalli as specified in schedule along with Maps with
Old Survey Numbers and new assigned to them.

Now therefore, in exercise of the Powers conferred by section 6 of The said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the person likely to be affected

thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the Notification in the official gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any person with respect to the said Proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestions may be addressed
to the Deputy Commissioner, Yadgir District, Yadgir

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the power conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966

such as the population, area of the village, the demand under land revenue in the
village and Other Head Of the account and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the government of Karnataka proposes to issue a notification to alter
the limits of Gogi(K) village of Shahapur Taluk Yadgir District and to constitute a
new villages called Rama Nayakana Halli, Gangoo Nayak Halli &
Revunayakana Halli as specified in schedule along with Maps with Old Survey
Numbers and new assigned to them.
Now therefore, in exercise of the Powers conferred by section 6 of The said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the person likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the Notification in the official gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any person with respect to the said Proposal before the date specified above
will be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestions may be
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Yadgir District, Yadgir

village called Rama Nayakana Halli of Shahapur Taluk, Yadgir district along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RD 407 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:04-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the
village and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative
convenience the Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter
the limits of Arakera B Village of Yadgir taluk Yadgir District and to constitute a
new revenue village called Santha Sevalal Nagar as specified in schedule along
with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Yadgir District, Yadgir

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Arakera B of Yadgir taluk in Yadgir District to form a new revenue village
called Santha Sevalal Nagar of Yadgir taluk Yadgir district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) there

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
No. RD.402 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretaraiat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:04-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the power conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village, the demand under land revenue in the
village and Other Head Of the account and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the government of Karnataka proposes to issue a notification to alter the
limits of Chamanal village of Shahapur Taluk Yadgir District and to constitute a
new village called Lachama Nayak Chamanal Tanda as specified in schedule along
with Maps with Old Survey Numbers and new assigned to them.

Now therefore, in exercise of the Powers conferred by section 6 of The said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the person likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the Notification in the official gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any person with respect to the said Proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestions may be addressed
to the Deputy Commissioner, Yadgir District, Yadgir

SCHEDULE-I
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Chamanal of Shahapur Taluk in Yadgir district to form the a new revenue
village called Lachama Nayak Chamanal Tanda of Shahapur Taluk, Yadgir
district along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966

such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Arankal Village of Kalagi taluk Kalaburgi District and to constitute a new revenue
village called Hanuman nagar and Eshwar nagar as specified in schedule along
with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Kalaburgi District, Kalaburgi

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Arankal of Kalagi taluk in Kalaburgi District to form a new revenue village
called Hanuman nagar of Kalagi taluk Kalaburgi district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.
